summary: operation_compile.py init no longer writes an empty source_hash, empty command fields or, without --constrained-by, an empty constrained_by relation into a new Verification or Environment Contract. The vault check rejected each of them, and the not-applicable mutation and dependency audit commands carried two of those errors into the approved contract. A command or relation now stays absent until its writer declares it, and approval names the missing key, a required command or constrained_by. Drafts that setup migrates from a retired config lose the same empty values.
